item.case_name: Text on screen in a clip
item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Coffee Clip Exact URL Ending

turns.text: Make a silent 8-second vertical coffee clip: a close-up of coffee being poured into a ceramic cup for 5 seconds, then a plain black end card for the last 3 seconds. Center this exact URL in white: https://example.com/Go?ref=June — keep the capitals and punctuation exactly as typed, all on one line. Nothing else written anywhere.

item.tests: Checks an exact case-sensitive URL rendered legibly on a timed end card rather than merely mentioned in the reply.

answer_sheet.Exact URL: https://example.com/Go?ref=June — no trailing punctuation, spaces or quotation marks.
answer_sheet.End card styling: Plain black background, centered white URL on one line; font is your call.
answer_sheet.Scene and timing: Coffee pouring into a ceramic cup for the first 5 seconds, followed by the end card for the final 3 seconds.
answer_sheet.Cup and setting details: Your call, provided the cup is ceramic and the pouring is shown close up.

must_haves: The first approximately 5 seconds show a close-up of coffee visibly pouring into a ceramic cup.
The final approximately 3 seconds are a plain black end card.
The end card reads exactly 'https://example.com/Go?ref=June', preserving uppercase G and J, the colon, slashes, question mark and equals sign.
The URL is centered in white on one line, fully inside the frame and readable throughout the end card.
No other written text appears anywhere in the video.
The delivered video is silent, 9:16 and approximately 8 seconds long.

args.name: Coffee Pour — Exact URL End Card

style.prompt: Create a silent vertical video, exactly 8 seconds total, with exactly two shots and a hard cut at precisely 5.000 seconds. Shot 1, time 0.000 through 5.000 seconds: photorealistic cinematic close-up of fresh hot coffee continuously being poured from a plain unmarked coffee pot into a plain ceramic cup. Warm soft natural light, subtle steam, rich coffee texture, cozy minimal setting, steady close-up camera. The coffee pour must be visible from the very first frame and continue throughout these first five seconds. No writing, letters, branding, logos, captions, or watermarks anywhere in this opening shot. Shot 2, time 5.000 through 8.000 seconds: a completely plain solid black static end card, with just one centered line of clean white text. The exact text is https://example.com/Go?ref=June . Render only the URL itself, excluding the preceding explanatory words and excluding the space and sentence period after it. Exact URL characters in order: h t t p s : / / e x a m p l e . c o m / G o ? r e f = J u n e (these character-list spaces are explanatory only and must NOT appear). Preserve uppercase G and J, lowercase all other letters, colon, both forward slashes after colon, dot, forward slash before Go, question mark and equals sign exactly. Fit the entire URL on ONE unbroken line centered horizontally and vertically, with ample side margins. No quotation marks, no leading or trailing spaces, no trailing punctuation. End card is perfectly still for all three final seconds, no fade, no animation. No other text anywhere in the video. Absolutely silent, no audio track, no music, no speech, no ambient sound.
